thread.title: Google parent Alphabet's stock closing in on first bear market in 7 years - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Google parent Alphabet's stock closing in on first bear market in 7 years - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Nov 19, 2018 2:36 p.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor
Share of Google parent Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -4.15% has dropped into bear market territory for the first time in seven years in afternoon trade Monday, amid a broad and sharp selloff in the technology sector. The stock was down 3.6%, on track for the lowest close since May 3, as the SPDR Technology Select Sector ETF XLK, -4.02% shed 3.7%, with all 65 of its components trading lower. The S&P 500 SPX, -1.89% was down 1.8%. Alphabet's stock's intraday low of $1,026.86, it was 20.1% below its July 26 record close of $1,285.50; many on Wall Street define a bear market as a decline of 20% or more from a bull-market peak. A close at or below $1,028.40 would mark the end of the current bull market, and start of a new bear market, since it came out of the last bear market on Oct. 14, 2011. The stock was last down 3.7% at 1,029.23. The other three original FANG stocks--Facebook Inc. FB, -5.85% Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -5.54% and Netflix Inc. NFLX, -5.80% --are already in bear markets, while the honorary FAANG stock--Apple Inc. AAPL, -4.35% also dipped into bear market territory intraday Monday before bouncing back out.
